requirements.text: The portal must allow patients to view available appointment slots in real-time and book their appointments directly.
The portal must provide a simple online process for patients to request prescription refills without needing to call the clinic.
The portal must include identity verification measures to ensure that only authorized patients can access their personal information.
Strong data protection protocols must be implemented to safeguard sensitive health information and maintain patient privacy.
The portal must include appointment reminders, which could be sent via text or email to help patients remember their upcoming appointments.
Patients should have the ability to view their test results online after they have been reviewed by a doctor.
